title: Greet and introduce yourself / Guda da koya muku da kansa
bridge: A cikin Turanci, don guda muna yi da 'Hello' ko 'Good morning', kuma don koya muku da kansa muna yi da 'My name is...' ko 'I am...'. Da yawa, a Turanci ba muna yi da 'I am called...' (har ma ba zan yi ba, amma yana da fasaha da yawa, amma ba ya dace ba a wata magana mai yawa). Da fatan za a sani cewa a Turanci muna yi da 'to be' don tambaya game da sunan: 'What is your name?' (ba 'How are you called?').
rule: Don guda: 'Hello' (Sannu), 'Hi' (mai yawan yawa), 'Good morning' (Barka da safe), 'Good afternoon' (Barka da rana), 'Good evening' (Barka da dare). Don koya muku da kansa: 'My name is...' (Sunan na ne...) ko 'I am...' (Na ne...). Don tambaya game da sunan: 'What is your name?' (Wane ne sunanka?). Don amsa ga guda: 'Nice to meet you' (Ya yi farin ciki da kowa) kuma amsa shine 'Nice to meet you too'. Don baya: 'Goodbye', 'Bye', 'See you later'.

concept_examples.translation: Barka da safe, na ne Peter.
Ya yi farin ciki da kowa.

common_error.explanation: A Turanci muna yi da 'My name is...' ko 'I am...' don koya muku da kansa. 'I am called' yana da fasaha amma yana da fasaha da yawa da ba dace ba a wata magana mai yawa.

examples.note: Tambaya mai fasaha don gano sunan.

title: Ba da bayanin juna (shekaru, kasuwanci, kasar)
bridge: A cikin Ingilishi, don bayar da shekaru muna cewa 'I am 25 years old' (da yin amfani da 'to be'), amma a cikin Hausa muna cewa 'Ina shekaru 25' (da yin amfani da 'ina'). Don kasar muna cewa 'I am Spanish' (da yin amfani da 'na'), amma a cikin Hausa muna cewa 'Na kasar Spain'. Don kasuwanci, a cikin Ingilishi muna cewa 'I am a teacher', amma a cikin Hausa muna cewa 'Ina aiki a matsayin mugu' (ba da wasu kalma ba).
rule: Don shekaru: 'I am [number] years old' (misali: I am 25 years old). Don kasar: 'I am [nationality]' (misali: I am Spanish, I am Mexican). Don kasuwanci: 'I am a/an [profession]' (misali: I am a doctor, I am an engineer). Don tambaya: 'How old are you?' (Ina shekaru?), 'Where are you from?' (Wa ya yi?), 'What do you do?' (Me kayi?) ko 'What is your job?'.

common_error.explanation: A cikin Ingilishi muna yin amfani da 'to be' don shekaru, amma a cikin Hausa muna yin amfani da 'ina'. Wannan ne wata matsala da ke faruwa ga manyan Hausawa.

examples.note: Muna yin amfani da 'to be' don shekaru.
Ba da wasu kalma ba don kasar.
Da yin amfani da 'a' ko 'an' don kasuwanci.

title: Bude watawa da mutane (nawa)
bridge: A Hausa, don bayyana watawa da mutane muna da tsarin 'sifa + suna': 'wata gida mai girma', 'wata yarinya mai girma'. A Turanci, sifa ta zama 'a gaba' na suna: 'a red car', 'a tall girl'. Muna kuma yin amfani da 'to be' don bayanin gaskiya (She is tall) da 'have got' don fasaha (She has got blue eyes).
rule: Don bayyana: 1) Sifa + suna (a big house). 2) Suna + 'to be' + sifa (The house is big). 3) Suna + 'have/has got' + fasaha (She has got long hair). Sifuffukkannu na yau: big (mai girma), small (mai yatsu), tall (mai girma), short (mai yatsu), beautiful (mai kyau), old (mai tsawo), young (sabo), fast (mai sauri), slow (mai rai).

concept_examples.translation: Ta mai girma da mai yatsu ce.

common_error.explanation: A Hausa, sifa ta zama 'a gaba' na suna ('wata mota mai jajja'), amma a Turanci sifa ta zama 'a gaba' na suna ('a red car'). Wannan ne wata matsala mai yawa ga waɗanda suka koyi Turanci.

examples.note: Sifa ta zama 'a gaba' na suna.
Muna yin amfani da 'to be' don bayanin gaskiya.

examples.translation: Ta yana da hairi mai rawa.
examples.note: Muna yin amfani da 'have got' don fasaha.

examples.original: My brother is young and he has got green eyes.
examples.phonetic: /maɪ ˈbrʌðə ɪz jʌŋ ænd hiː hæz ɡɒt ɡriːn aɪz/
examples.translation: Yaro na na sabo ne kuma yana da ido na green.
